subject: maths
question: On an 18% discount sale, an article costs Rs. 6,560. What is the marked price of the article?
solution:
Given:

On an 18% discount sale, an article costs Rs. 6,560.

Concept used:

Selling Price = Marked Price × (1 - Discount%)

Calculation:

Now, the marked price of the article = 6560 ÷ (1 - 18%) = Rs. 8000

**∴ The marked price of the article is Rs. 8000.**
